wins: Documented full surface mapping of accessible subnets and captured initial service banners before escalation attempts
Maintained persistent connectivity with the training lab despite repeated network resets, enabling consistent data collection
fails: Failed to achieve mission objective — exploitation chain never completed after 10 mentor calls and no successful payload delivery
Repeated remediation attempts were required because privilege escalation steps did not progress past locked-down services
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was thorough, but the team repeatedly stalled during lateral movement and never completed exploitation; focus now should shift to aggressive service enumeration and prioritized access paths.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Every exploitation attempt stalled immediately after initial port scan, indicating pivoting efforts never reached a vulnerable service

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner reveals OpenSSH
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to grab version details and supported ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP port responds with multi-stage redirect chains
skill_cards.then_action: Pipe requests through Burp’s intruder to trace headers and look for weak session identifiers

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential reuse is suspected after initial recon
skill_cards.then_action: Use CrackMapExec to test common AD credentials across found hosts

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
Repeatedly surfaced new data during HTTP analysis

next_experiments.title: HTTP session fixation probing
next_experiments.description: Craft chained requests targeting HTTP endpoints uncovered during recon to identify weak session controls, then attempt cookie reuse for privilege escalation.

next_experiments.title: SMB credential spraying with rotated accounts
next_experiments.description: Apply CrackMapExec across discovered hosts with a curated credential set while capturing failed login patterns, aiming to find an exploitable account before further lateral movement.

next_experiments.title: Aggressive SSH tunneling follow-up
next_experiments.description: After running SSH enumeration, attempt to manually brute-force weak ciphers and escalate to interactive shell with sourced credentials to validate access path.
